named_question: How does editing an existing mood CID swap bindings, normalize special SIDs and update selection references without conflating append overrides?

static_byte_pins.purpose: Complete handler, including omitted selected-SID argument, early SID write and ordered remapping calls.
Grid caller passes selected record SID and requested CID to the handler.
OpM, ScMv and ScAc binding labels.
Comma delimiter in the type18 integer-vector reader.

caller: Grid-edit callback0x1400ea790 column1 derives CID from the displayed input, then calls0x1400e6200(dialog, selected-record SID, CID). The handler looks up the selected record by SID and the first existing record with requested CID. The subsequent GUI grid refresh is not reproduced.
ordered_transaction: If requested CID is occupied by a different record and is nonzero, give that record the selected record's previous CID, then assign requested CID to the selected record. Otherwise assign the selected CID without a swap.

In the occupied-nonzero swap branch, if the other record SID is at least776, first assign the selected record the lowest free SID1..99. This early write does not call the selection-reference remapper.

Normalize the selected record: CID22 forces SID777; CID24 forces SID776; otherwise a SID at least776 becomes the lowest free SID1..99. When this step changes SID, remap references from this step's previous SID to the new SID.

If the initial CID lookup found a record, normalize that same record by the same rules using its current values, including when requested CID is0 or when it is the selected record. Remap its changed SID afterward.
Apply reference remaps in that exact sequence. Do not combine them into a simultaneous UUID-based rename map: a later remap can intentionally match the result of an earlier one.

selection_reference_binding.record: Dialog+0x188 is LSConfig copied from original controller+0x2218.
selection_reference_binding.vectors: OpM binds base+8, ScMv base+0x28 and ScAc base+0x48. The remapper0x1405b6c00 iterates the OpM length and replaces matching SID values only in in-range ScMv entries.
selection_reference_binding.codec: The reused type18 attribute codec reads comma-delimited integers. CLI supports signed-32-bit decimal tokens with ASCII surrounding whitespace and no empty tokens, rather than copying native truncation/default parsing.
selection_reference_binding.preservation: Missing/empty OpM or ScMv produces no reference writes. Needed ScMv prefix is bounded by both vector lengths; unvisited tail tokens, ScAc, OpM spellings and all other data remain untouched.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting set-mood-cid FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME --cid N [--room ROOM] [--save-as PATH]
CLI_policy.bounds: Nonnegative signed-32-bit requested CID, exactly one direct collection, explicit signed-32-bit Num equal to direct scene count, one unambiguous exact Name/SID target, explicit distinct positive signed-32-bit SIDs and unique nonzero CIDs. Repeated CID0 uses first stored match. Absent CID has source-backed effective0 and retains omission when unchanged; present malformed/negative/out-of-range identities fail.
CLI_policy.atomicity: Plan all identity and needed reference writes before mutation. Reject exhausted SID1..99 allocation and final SID collisions instead of native SID0 or ambiguous role states. Unsupported needed LSConfig shapes/lists fail without changing input or save-as destination.
CLI_policy.report: JSON reports affected identity records with exact before/after spellings, ordered selection_remaps, optional ScMv comparison and changed. Table/CSV expose cohort changes; no-op in-place preserves original bytes.
CLI_policy.preservation: Only affected SID/CID attributes and required ScMv tokens change. Existing writer formatting and Document stamps retain normal behavior. Do not recount, resize, edit Qn/color/type flags, refresh HCL, reorder records or normalize unrelated data.
CLI_policy.compatibility: Existing add-mood --sid/--cid overrides and raw set-mood-color behavior are unchanged. This is a separate existing-record transaction, not append override allocation.

regressions: src/config_edit/lighting_cid.rs and tests/lighting_cid_source.rs: ordinary swaps, role promotions/demotions, ordered reference cascades, CID0 first-match behavior, omitted-CID preservation, equivalent-spelling no-op and atomic invalid/ambiguous/exhausted failures.

native_validation.dependency: Notebook authenticated transport was unreachable at the batch's single readiness assessment. Native packet is independent; no previous machine result is reused.
native_validation.limits: Source-backed handler transaction and local CLI persistence only. Not a complete native grid vocabulary, import model, post-refresh/save transaction, hardware mapping, native GUI or runtime parity.
